title: Slack
intro: Bind a Slack app to one of your saved agents. People talk to the agent in a direct message with the app, or by mentioning it in a channel: the answer goes in a thread, and each thread is a conversation of its own.
name: Name
botTokenHelp: Starts with xoxb-. From OAuth & Permissions of your app. It is kept sealed and never shown again.
appTokenHelp: Starts with xapp-, with the scope connections:write. From Basic Information, App-Level Tokens. LocalAI uses it for Socket Mode, so it needs no public address.
tokenSaved: Saved. Type both tokens to replace them.
tokensBoth: Type both tokens: the bot token and the app-level token.
botShape: The bot token starts with xoxb-.
appShape: The app-level token starts with xapp-.
onlyListed: Only the people and channels I list
anyone: Anyone in the workspace who can message the app
anyoneWarning: Anyone who can message this app or mention it can use this agent's tools, as you. Each person, and each thread, gets a conversation of its own.
allowChannelsHint: Channel ID (C...): everyone in it may mention the app
notifyChat: Send my notifications to this user or channel ID
notifyHelp: Optional. Your user ID (U...) sends them as direct messages from the app.
noSenders: Nobody has written to this app yet.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.message: The app stops answering, and the tokens saved with it are deleted. To set it up again you must enter the tokens again.

setup.title: How to make the Slack app
setup.step1: At api.slack.com/apps choose Create New App, From an app manifest, pick your workspace and paste the manifest below.
setup.step2: Install the app to the workspace, and copy the bot token (xoxb-) from OAuth & Permissions.
setup.step3: In Basic Information, App-Level Tokens, make a token with the scope connections:write and copy it (xapp-).
setup.step4: Make a binding here with both tokens. To use the app in a channel, invite it there (/invite @LocalAI).
